It is the boat operator\u2019s responsibility to be alert to the safety of the wake boarder or water-skier and others. The following are some important considerations for minimizing risks while pulling a wake boarder or water-skier. \uf06c The wake boarder or water-skier should wear an approved PFD, preferably a brightly colored one so boat operators can see the person being pulled. \uf06c The wake boarder or water-skier should wear protective clothing. Normal swimwear does not adequately protect against forceful water entry into the rectum or vagina.
